cm.c: It’s amazing how something as simple as planting trees can make such a big difference those “green walls” really saved the land and people’s lives
This was an FDR project, the only US president who understood that investing into infrastructure with no expectation of immediate quartely profits is actually good for society
We always talk about dust bowl, but never about what ended the dust bowl. Thanks for this, never knew!
I’m 70 and have never heard this before. I heard of the dust bowl, but never the line of trees.
It's not just serving as a windbreak, the roots of the trees also stabilize the soil.
My great grandmother wrote about these dust storms in her journal. Her father helped plant the trees. He was part of a tribe that lived in the hills at the foot of the mountains
This YouTube short taught me more about the dust bowl than school ever did.

I remembered in Oklahoma sometime in the 90s as a kid. There was a massive dust storm. It was terrifying. I got stuck in it and couldn't breath or see. Luckily my brother came to find me. I was hunker
It’s amazing how trees make all the difference in the environment. They clean the air, cool the climate, protect the soil, support wildlife, and make our world healthier and more alive.
